SELECT * FROM ( SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.group_code ORDER BY x.owned DESC, x.play_count DESC, x.id DESC) AS rn FROM ( SELECT b.*, c.id AS cat_id, c.name AS cat_name, c.name_en AS cat_name_en, c.code AS cat_code, c.color AS cat_color, c.icon AS cat_icon, c.parent_id AS cat_parent_id, pc.name AS cat_parent_name, pc.name_en AS cat_parent_name_en, pc.code AS cat_parent_code, u.nickname AS uploader_nickname, COALESCE(pc.code, c.code) AS group_code, (ub.block_id IS NOT NULL) AS owned FROM block b JOIN sound_category c ON c.id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN sound_category pc ON pc.id = c.parent_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = b.uploader_id LEFT JOIN user_block ub ON ub.block_id = b.id AND ub.user_id = #{userId} WHERE b.is_active = true AND b.status = 'APPROVED' AND (ub.block_id IS NOT NULL OR (b.price = 0 AND b.is_listed = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_hidden_creator hc WHERE hc.user_id = #{userId} AND hc.creator_id = b.uploader_id))) AND COALESCE(pc.code, c.code) IN #{code} ) x ) y WHERE y.rn <= #{perGroup} ORDER BY y.group_code, y.rn
